recipes.title: Crispy Rice Paper Beef Protein Bites with Spicy Peanut Sauce

items.i: green onions, finely chopped (plus extra to serve)

steps: Mix the beef with the green onion, carrot, garlic, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Dip a rice paper sheet in water until just pliable, lay it flat, spoon a log of filling along one edge and roll up tightly.
Snip each roll into 3–4 bite-size pieces with scissors.
Arrange on parchment in the air fryer, spray with oil and cook at 200°C (400°F) for 12–15 minutes until crisp and golden.
Whisk the sauce ingredients, thinning with warm water. Scatter the bites with sesame seeds and green onion and serve with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the creators share the full recipe and macros only by DM ("comment built") and in their sauce eBook, so the filling and sauce here are estimates based on the video. Swap in ground chicken or turkey if you like.
